title: RS_SummaryStats
description: >
  Returns one summary statistic of a band's pixel values as a double.
kernels:
  - returns: double
    args:
    - raster
    - name: stat_type
      type: string
      description: >
        One of `count`, `sum`, `mean`, `stddev`, `min` or `max`
        (case-insensitive). `stddev` is the population standard deviation.
  - returns: double
    args:
    - raster
    - name: stat_type
      type: string
      description: >
        One of `count`, `sum`, `mean`, `stddev`, `min` or `max`
        (case-insensitive). `stddev` is the population standard deviation.
    - name: band
      type: integer
      description: Band index (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.
  - returns: double
    args:
    - raster
    - name: stat_type
      type: string
      description: >
        One of `count`, `sum`, `mean`, `stddev`, `min` or `max`
        (case-insensitive). `stddev` is the population standard deviation.
    - name: band
      type: integer
      description: Band index (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.
    - name: exclude_nodata
      type: boolean
      description: >
        Whether to leave pixels holding the band's nodata value out of the
        statistic. Defaults to true.
---

## Description

Over no pixels (for example, a band that is entirely nodata), `count` and
`sum` are 0 and the other statistics are NaN. A NaN pixel is left out as
nodata when the band's nodata value is NaN; otherwise it is data and makes
`sum`, `mean` and `stddev` NaN, while `min` and `max` skip it. Only
2-D rasters are supported.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_SummaryStats(RS_Example(), 'mean');
```

```sql
SELECT RS_SummaryStats(RS_Example(), 'count', 1, false);
```
